methods.name: notetypes.list
methods.description: List note types with kinds and note-use counts.

methods.name: notetypes.get
methods.description: Read fields, templates, stylesheet and note-type options.

methods.name: notetypes.add
methods.description: Create from exactly one complete definition or stockKind; name overrides only a stock definition.

methods.name: notetypes.clone
methods.description: Clone a note type's fields, templates and styling.

methods.name: notetypes.update
methods.description: Update fields, templates and styling in one native undo step; await the terminal progress result. Array order is final, ord is the old ordinal or null for a new item, and sortField is the final field index. Selecting a new field before the last position is unsupported before writing when its index matches a retained old ordinal: save the schema with the last field as sortField, reload, then select the new sort field.

methods.name: notetypes.rename
methods.description: Rename a note type without changing its identity.

methods.name: notetypes.remove
methods.description: Remove a note type and its notes only after explicit confirmation; the terminal progress result includes the removed note count.

methods.name: notetypes.stock
methods.description: Return stock definitions for Basic, reversed, optional reversed, type-in, Cloze and image occlusion.

methods.name: notetypes.previewTemplate
methods.description: Render unsaved edits without changing the active collection. templateOrdinal is the final template index or zero-based cloze number. A supplied cardId must match the selected template's retained ord or cloze number; a new normal template has no existing card identity. With noteId alone, use its matching existing card when available, otherwise native uncommitted sample/default context. Fields may be explicit, taken from the note, or native samples.

methods.name: notetypes.changeNotetype
methods.description: Convert notes of one source type; the terminal progress result includes the converted note count. Maps list a source ordinal per destination, -1 means blank/new, and templateMap must be empty for cloze conversions.
